ov: النيام (الإنجليزية: Sleepers) هو فيلم أمريكي من إخراج باري ليفينسون أصدر سنة 1996 مستوحى من وقائع حقيقية ومقتبس من الرواية الحاملة لنفس الاسم التي ألفها لورانزو كاركاتيرا.
plotEn:
In Hell's Kitchen, Manhattan in the summer of 1967, childhood friends Lorenzo "Shakes" Carcaterra, Tommy Marcano, Michael Sullivan and John Reilly are running small errands for local gangster "King" Benny. After they injure a man by accidentally rolling a stolen hot-dog cart down a set of subway stairs, the boys are sentenced to serve time at the juvenile detention center Wilkinson Home for Boys in Upstate New York. Shakes had considered fleeing to avoid prosecution, but Father Bobby Carillo convinced him to face his fears and admit his wrongs. Shakes receives six-to-twelve months, while the others are given 12-to-18 months. 
During their incarceration, the boys experience sexual abuse and torture from guards Sean Nokes, Henry Addison, Ralph Ferguson and Adam Styler. The boys participate in Wilkinson's annual football game between the guards and inmates and with the help of inmate "Rizzo" Robinson, they win the game. The humiliated guards move the boys to solitary confinement for weeks, where they're systematically beaten. Rizzo, an African-American, is beaten more severely and dies. His family is told that he died of pneumonia. In the spring of 1968, shortly before his release, Shakes suggests they publicly report the abuse but the others refuse, thinking no one would believe or care about such a report. The boys vow to never speak of the abuse again. The night before Shakes' release, the guards arrange a "farewell party" at which all four boys are raped.
